name: omitly-leak-check
description: Local, offline check for exposed or recoverable sensitive content in PDFs, plus verification of a redacted PDF. Diagnosis only — nothing is uploaded, nothing is redacted. Actual removal is the licensed Omitly desktop app.
long_description: Omitly Redaction Leak Check runs entirely on your machine: it re-extracts the text layer of a PDF (including text hidden under black-box redaction marks, superseded incremental-update revisions, metadata, and form fields) and reports anything that looks like PII — emails, SSNs, phone numbers, card numbers, and Australian identifiers (TFN/ABN/ACN/Medicare/CRN/IHI/BSB). This is a diagnosis-only tool: it never redacts a file and never issues a certificate. To actually remove sensitive data with a verifiable, offline-checkable proof of removal, use the licensed Omitly desktop app (https://omitly.app).

allowed_dir.title: Folder Omitly can scan
allowed_dir.description: The four diagnosis tools (check_redaction, find_sensitive_regions, locate_text, verify_redaction) can only read PDFs under this folder — nothing else on your machine is accessible to them. Pick the folder containing the documents you want checked.

tools.name: check_redaction
tools.description: Audit an already-redacted PDF on-device and report whether sensitive text still survives underneath the redaction marks, in superseded revisions, metadata, or form fields. Diagnosis only — never redacts, never issues a certificate. Free tier: EVALUATION-marked reports, monthly cap on free checks (counted locally; past the cap the tool returns a structured 'free-cap' refusal).

tools.name: find_sensitive_regions
tools.description: Scan a local PDF on-device for candidate PII regions (email/SSN/phone/card plus Australian TFN/ABN/ACN/Medicare/CRN/IHI/BSB) with page and coordinates. Diagnosis only — does not redact. Free tier: EVALUATION-marked results, monthly cap on free checks (counted locally).

tools.name: locate_text
tools.description: Locate literal strings (names, addresses, account references) in a local PDF on-device and return their page and coordinates. Diagnosis only — does not redact.

tools.name: verify_redaction
tools.description: Re-scan an already-redacted PDF on-device and report whether anything recoverable remains. Works offline; makes no vendor-trust claim beyond what it re-scans.
